title: Beforest 10% Club
description: The Art of Return: Strategic Wilderness Integration

slides.title: The Art of Return
slides.content: Spending 30 nights a year in the deep quiet of the wilderness.
slides.notes: Introduce the concept: 10% of your year dedicated to wilderness. Emphasize the transformative power of consistent nature immersion.

slides.title: We are a species in exile.
slides.content: Success was supposed to be the finish line, not just the beginning of a race we never chose.
slides.notes: Describe the urban trap: endless meetings, empty calendars. The average urban professional spends less than 2% outdoors. We are tourists on our own planet.

slides.title: 30 Nights a Year
slides.content: Enough time to reset your circadian rhythm. A decade of guaranteed wilderness access. No ownership headaches. Just pure belonging.
slides.notes: Explain the 10% solution: 30 nights annually, 10-year commitment, zero hassle. The math of transformation.

slides.title: Across India's wildest landscapes.
slides.content: Poomaale 1.0, Coorg · Poomaale 2.0, Coorg · Hammiyala, Coorg · Hyderabad · Bhopal · Mumbai
slides.notes: Showcase the sanctuaries: each with unique character. Ancient forests, coffee plantations, grasslands, deccan plateau, central highlands, maximum city's silence.

slides.title: Who is this for
slides.content: The Naturalist · The Seeker · The Authenticist · The Pioneer
slides.notes: Describe the four archetypes: those who belong to wilderness, seek profound solitude, reject performative travel, ready to answer the call.

slides.title: This is a commitment, not a consumption.
slides.content: The Quick Fix Seeker · The Weekend Reveler · The Luxury Collector · The Networker
slides.notes: Clarify who this is not for: those seeking quick fixes, party backdrops, trophy experiences, or transactional networking.

slides.title: We have held a seat under the trees for you.
slides.content: Sign up for the webinar — no commitment, just a real dialogue about what this could mean for you.
slides.notes: Final call to action: invite to webinar. Emphasize no commitment, real dialogue. End with the seat under the trees metaphor.
